# @stolyarovmn/dsh-client-ui-schedule-tab 0.8.1

Stable promotion of `0.8.1-rc.1` for DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` through `0.2.1-rc.4`. Runtime code is unchanged from the validated RC.

## Compatibility

- Declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh >=0.2.1-rc.2 <=0.2.1-rc.4`.
- Install and Web boot smoke tests pass on DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.3`, and `0.2.1-rc.4`.
- Real DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` Chromium validation passed before promotion.

## Included

- unread Automation Tasks badge and scheduled-Session attention;
- delivery popup and browser-local notification switches;
- native TaskManager/TaskDetail behavior, Rules editing, timing controls and Delivery records;
- Queue/Delete row quick actions, first-click native delete confirmation, and linked-Session navigation;
- current DSH display resource export `"./icon": "./icon.svg"`.

## Validation

- `npm run check`: pass on the RC candidate promoted by this release;
- `npm pack --dry-run`: pass;
- native Schedule snapshot build: pass;
- real DSH `0.2.1-rc.4` browser smoke verified Plugin Manager loading, SVG artwork and the native Automation Tasks manager without plugin/runtime crashes.

This version is the stable npm release and is intended to be published under dist-tag `latest`.
